purpose: Home-only modest character variants for the classroom and night study room cards
scope: Only RoomCard requests getHomeRoomArtwork. Shared scene artwork, detail banners, friend portraits, study/report artwork, and welcome banners keep their existing assets.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent character foreground for the HOME PAGE room card of an anime study companion website.
Input image 1: existing character group, used as the identity and illustration-style reference and edit target.
Primary request: Regenerate this same three-person group as a wholesome, modest, friendly study scene. Preserve the distinctive three faces, hair colors and hairstyles, and left-to-right identities: short dark bob-haired Sua on the left, very long blonde-haired Chaerin in the center, brown ponytail-haired Dahee on the right. Preserve the detailed softly painted anime illustration style, warm sunset highlights and dark gray school-uniform palette. Sua is gentle, Chaerin has a reserved slightly aloof expression, Dahee has a cheerful small smile.
Change clothing and pose: wear loose, fully buttoned white collared shirts with tidy ties and modest dark vests or cardigans; calf-length pleated charcoal skirts and opaque dark leggings, simple loafers. All three sit upright next to one another on simple understated study chairs, naturally reading or holding their notebooks and pen. Their hands and books are relaxed near their laps or midriff, shoulders level. Their knees stay together BELOW the waist, lower legs point down and feet rest naturally on the same implied floor; there are no raised knees, crossed legs, low-angle camera views or foreshortened legs. Eye-level viewpoint. Keep faces prominent, proportions natural, all three heads approximately level. Head-to-foot full bodies in landscape 1536x1024 with a small transparent margin around all hair, shoes and outer edges. Keep the group compact enough to read clearly in a room thumbnail.
Constraints: EXACTLY three people, anatomically clear hands and exactly two legs per person. Clothing covers torso and upper legs fully, regular relaxed tailoring with no exaggerated anatomy or body emphasis. Genuine transparent alpha outside and between the figures and any simple chair silhouettes. Only the people, their notebooks/pen, and minimal chairs; no room, floor plane, tabletop, background texture, gradients, colored haze, ground shadows, text, UI, lettering, logo or watermark. The existing environment and title are separate website layers and must not be generated into this image.
